nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:

user  nginx;
worker_processes  auto;

error_log  /var/log/nginx/error.log notice;
pid        /run/nginx.pid;


events {
    worker_connections  1024;
}


http {
    include       /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type  application/octet-stream;

    log_format  main  '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                      '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" '
                      '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for"';

    access_log  /var/log/nginx/access.log  main;

    sendfile        on;
    #tcp_nopush     on;

    keepalive_timeout  65;

    #gzip  on;

    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/00-upstreams.conf:
# Demo upstream pools. demo-* hosts are real containers (healthy);
# 10.255.x.x addresses intentionally do not exist, so they show as DOWN in the service map.
upstream api_v1 {
    server demo-api:5678;
    server demo-app:5678;
}

upstream api_v2 {
    server demo-api:5678 weight=3;
    server 10.255.0.21:8080;            # dead → api_v2 is DEGRADED
}

upstream auth_svc {
    server demo-auth:5678;
}

upstream payments {
    server 10.255.0.31:9000;            # dead
    server 10.255.0.32:9000 backup;     # dead → payments is DOWN
}

upstream search_cluster {
    server demo-app:5678;
    server 10.255.0.41:9200;            # dead → DEGRADED
}

upstream ws_gateway {
    server demo-app:5678;
}

upstream legacy_backend {
    server 10.255.0.51:8080;            # dead
}

limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=login_limit:10m rate=5r/s;

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/10-api.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name api.local api.example.local;

    location /v1/ {
        proxy_pass http://api_v1/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
    location /v2/ {
        proxy_pass http://api_v2/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /v2/search {
        proxy_pass http://search_cluster;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location = /health { return 200 "ok\n"; }
    location /docs/ { alias /usr/share/nginx/html/; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/20-shop.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name shop.local www.shop.local;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;

    location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html; }
    location /api/cart/ {
        proxy_pass http://api_v2/cart/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /api/checkout/ {
        proxy_pass http://payments/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /api/search {
        proxy_pass http://search_cluster;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location ^~ /assets/ { expires 30d; }
    location ~* \.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp|svg)$ { expires 7d; access_log off; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/30-auth.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name auth.local;

    location /login {
        limit_req zone=login_limit burst=10 nodelay;
        proxy_pass http://auth_svc;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /oauth/ {
        proxy_pass http://auth_svc/oauth/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /.well-known/ { proxy_pass http://auth_svc; proxy_set_header Host $host; }
    location / { return 404; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/40-realtime.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name ws.local;

    location /socket/ {
        proxy_pass http://ws_gateway;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }
    location /events {
        proxy_pass http://ws_gateway;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/50-admin.conf:
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name admin.local;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://api_v1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /billing/ {
        proxy_pass http://payments;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /reports/ {
        proxy_pass http://legacy_backend;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location = /nginx_status {
        stub_status;
        allow 127.0.0.1;
        deny all;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/60-static.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name static.local cdn.local;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;

    location / { try_files $uri =404; }
    location /downloads/ { alias /usr/share/nginx/html/; autoindex on; }   # lint: autoindex
    location ~* \.(css|js)$ { expires 30d; add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable"; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/70-legacy.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name old.local legacy.local;
    return 301 http://shop.local$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name reports.local;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://legacy_backend;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
    location /archive/ {
        proxy_pass http://legacy_backend/archive/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:
# Demo config. Contains a few deliberate lint findings so you can see the Problems panel.
upstream demo_app {
    server demo-app:5678;
}

server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    server_name localhost;
    server_tokens on;                       # lint: server-tokens

    add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;

    location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;
    }

    location /api {
        proxy_pass http://demo_app/;        # lint: proxy-pass-slash (/api/foo -> //foo)
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;   # lint: Host not set
    }

    location /ok/ {
        proxy_pass http://demo_app/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
}
